ruleDefinitions.name: Private Keys Reconnaissance Via CommandLine Tools
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may search for private key certificate files on compromised systems for insecurely stored credential

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.key.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pgp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.gpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ppk.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.p12.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pem.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.pfx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cer.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.p7b.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.asc.*")) AND (((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dir\\ .*")) OR (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-ChildItem\\ .*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\findstr\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "FINDSTR\.EXE"))
